settings.heading:
Nothing but
the cup
settings.body: Plant-derived lyocell filters for the Hario V60. No paper taste, no pre-rinse, no compromise — just a clean, bright pour every time.

settings.heading: The collection
settings.subtext: Everything we make is designed to get out of the way and let the coffee speak.

settings.heading: Two materials, one purpose
settings.subtext: Lyocell gives you a flavour-neutral sheet. PLA gives it the structure to hold its shape under a full, heavy pour.

settings.title: No pre-rinse
settings.description: Lyocell carries no paper taste. Skip the rinse step entirely — one less thing between you and your first sip.

settings.title: Fine filtration
settings.description: Tight fibre structure catches fine coffee particles while letting the oils that carry brightness and sweetness through.

settings.title: Certified compostable
settings.description: Both lyocell and PLA are plant-derived and certified industrially compostable — grounds and all, no separation needed.
